title: Devin
summary: Cognition's Devin CLI driven by agentd's built-in adapter. The vendor's CLI is installed separately.
description: A first-party descriptor of one of agentd's built-in harness adapters (design 73 section 8, D1464). The listing describes Loams' adapter, which is Apache-2.0 and ships inside loams-agentd; the vendor's CLI is installed separately (Settings can run the vendor's official installer) and found on PATH or through its `*_EXECUTABLE` override. The vendor's software is separate, under its own licence and terms. agentd launches it as `devin acp` and speaks ACP over stdio; sign-in is `devin auth login` or ACP `authenticate`.
